news.title: Man accused of murder, kidnapping captured south of Atlanta
news.summary: A man accused of murder and kidnapping in the metro Atlanta area was captured Thursday.

news.title: DeKalb County police searching for missing 14-year-old boy
news.summary: DeKalb County police are asking for the public's help to find 14-year-old Chase, who went missing on July 24 after leaving Hyatt Circle wearing a black hoodie, blue track pants, and blue Nike slides.

news.title: Inman Park public indecency case leads to suspect surrender
news.summary: A 34-year-old man turned himself in to Atlanta police after a woman reported seeing him exposing himself along an Inman Park sidewalk.

news.title: DeKalb County child molestation suspect hundreds of miles away
news.summary: A DeKalb County molestation suspect is in custody after fugitive investigators found him in Alabama.

news.title: Atlanta shooting leads to arrest of gang member, 2 wanted men
news.summary: An investigation into a shooting at a southwest Atlanta home on July 17 led to the arrest of three wanted men, according to police.
